paper.title_en: Tidal Response and Thermodynamics of Black Holes
paper.abstract_en: In this work, we revisit black hole Love numbers from two complementary perspectives. First, we develop a manifestly gauge-invariant framework that directly integrates out the short-distance degrees of freedom of a static black hole in arbitrary spacetime dimensions. This approach yields the effective point-particle action and its associated Love numbers without relying on the standard matching procedure or on the Regge-Wheeler equation and its associated master field. Second, we investigate the role of Love numbers in black hole thermodynamics by analyzing a Schwarzschild black hole subjected to various types of external perturbations. We show that Love numbers govern the induced polarization of the black hole and control the leading corrections to its thermodynamic properties, thereby clarifying their physical significance in black hole thermodynamics.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文从规范不变和热力学两个互补视角重新审视黑洞的Love数，提供了新的理论框架并阐明其热力学意义，属于黑洞热力学领域的前沿工作。
decision.title_zh: 黑洞的潮汐响应与热力学
decision.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们从两个互补的视角重新审视黑洞的Love数。首先，我们发展了一个显式规范不变的框架，该框架直接积掉任意时空维度中静态黑洞的短距离自由度。这种方法无需依赖标准匹配程序或Regge-Wheeler方程及其相关主场，即可得到有效点粒子作用量及其相关的Love数。其次，我们通过分析受到各种类型外部扰动的Schwarzschild黑洞，研究Love数在黑洞热力学中的作用。我们表明，Love数控制着黑洞的感应极化，并控制其热力学性质的首阶修正，从而阐明它们在黑洞热力学中的物理意义。
